sections.voiceover: Meritservus and Deloitte Cyprus helped Roman Abramovich shift superyachts, mansions and private jets out of reach.

sections.voiceover: Meritservus backdated corporate records to protect $672 million in assets. Meritservus falsified 1,000 corporate papers across the British Virgin Islands.
